title: Open Field Test Protocol for Mice
author: Ana Catarina Carapinha Cascalho
materials: Start the computer and open the ANY-maze tracking software (for more information of the ANY-maze software, go to: https://www.any-maze.com/) .
Upload your protocol OR make a new protocol.
Define the video sources (4) and apparatus.
When the 30min are finished the software will automatically stop tracking the animal. Move the tested mouse to a new cage if non-tested mice are still present in the original cage.

steps.title: Initial Room Acclimation
steps.instruction: Acclimate mice in their home cages within the testing room.

substeps.instruction: Place mice in the testing room in home cages for approximately 00:10:00.
Leave the room during this acclimation period.

steps.title: Environment Mimicry
steps.instruction: Prepare the testing environment by activating the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Return to the testing room and turn on the activity chambers.

steps.title: Chamber Loading and Acclimation
steps.instruction: Transfer mice to the test chambers for a secondary acclimation period.

substeps.instruction: Gently remove each mouse from their home cage and immediately place them in the test chambers.
If the activity chamber has a center divider dividing it into quadrants, place one mouse into each empty quadrant.
Leave the room for 00:10:00 once all animals are loaded.

steps.title: Post-Acclimation Cleanup
steps.instruction: Return mice to cages and sanitize the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Return to the room after 00:10:00 and gently return each mouse to their respective home cage.
Clean each chamber with disinfectant and paper towels, ensuring no dirt particles remain.
If running multiple sessions per day, thoroughly clean each test chamber between sessions with ammonium.

steps.title: Software Configuration
steps.instruction: Configure the behavior and testing parameters in the software.

substeps.instruction: Define 3 zones: Periphery (Edge + 6.5 cm), Non-periphery, and Center (17.5 cm from the edge).
Set immobility sensitivity to 70% and minimum immobility period to 5s.
Set minimum freezing detection to 5000 milliseconds.
Set the first stage test duration to 1800s.
In the experiment tab, enter the number of animals per treatment to be tested.

steps.title: Pre-Test Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare animals for the actual test session.

substeps.instruction: Place animals in the testing room for at least 00:30:00 for acclimatization.
Ensure mice groups are randomized and run intercalated to avoid hour/group interplay.

steps.title: Conduct Open Field Test
steps.instruction: Execute the testing procedure for the mice.

substeps.instruction: Move the animal directly from the home cage to the open field testing box without prior manipulation.
If using 4 open field boxes, move each mouse to a box.
Go to the Tests tab and press 'start all' to track all 4 mice via software.
Remove yourself from the room or the mice's field of view to avoid interference and noise.
Identify the paw tattoo/ear tag after the test is performed.

steps.title: Post-Test Cleanup and Iteration
steps.instruction: Clean the equipment and repeat the process for subsequent animals.

substeps.instruction: Clean the testing box.
Repeat the testing process for the next mice.
Randomize the order of mice each day to avoid daytime influence.
If testing the same animal throughout the study, avoid measuring them more than once a month to avoid habituation.
